Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Bell’s AI Fabric initiative is pioneering a secure, sovereign AI compute network across Canada. This transformative portfolio includes seven large-scale, high-density data centres, anchored by a 500 MW British Columbia supercluster and a future 1.2GW flagship site in Regina, Saskatchewan.

Who We Are

Founded in 2013, Ignition is the leading revenue and billing automation platform for firms and agencies. We automate proposals, invoicing, payments and workflows in a single AI-powered platform, empowering businesses to sell, bill and get paid faster.

Ignition automates proposals, engagement letters, invoicing, payments and workflows in a single AI-powered platform, empowering 8,500+ businesses to sell, bill and get paid for their services with ease.

To date, Ignition customers have managed relationships with over 2.4 million clients and earned $13b in revenue via the platform. Ignition's global workforce spans Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the Philippines, US and the UK.

Company Values

We are better everyday
We work without ego
We are smarter together
We hero our customer

About The Role

Ignition helps accounting firms price confidently, bill everything and get paid faster. Ignition runs the revenue side of 8,500+ accounting firms. We’re looking for the person who builds the digital engine that finds the next 10,000, in every region we sell. You will own the pipeline Ignition generates through digital channels, in every region we sell. You'll lead performance marketing (SEO, AEO (answer engine optimization), paid search, paid social), lifecycle and nurture, and the website, co-owning pipeline and revenue with our sales leaders in every region.

This is a hands-on, test-and-learn leadership role where AI is at the core of how marketing gets done: enabling you to run the work, build reporting, and quickly spot and fix issues. This role goes beyond channels and you’ll help shape how marketing and sales work together, along with working closely with RevOps, Product Marketing and regional marketing teams across AMER, APAC and the UK.

Where And How We Work

We're a global team across Canada, the US, Australia and the UK. We work asynchronously where we can and offer flexible hours to make cross-time-zone collaboration work.

What You’ll Do

Own and grow the global digital pipeline:

Co-own the digital pipeline and revenue targets for AMER, APAC and UK, with AMER as the largest market.
Set the global channel strategy and adapt it by region and segment, from SMB to mid-market and enterprise firms.
Grow self-serve trials and signups alongside sales-led pipeline initiatives
Manage and optimize the paid media budget across search, social and other CPC channels, quickly reallocating spend to the best-performing campaigns.
Partner with regional marketing and product marketing in every region so digital programs amplify launches, campaigns and events.

Co-own Pipeline And Revenue With Sales

Build a true partnership with regional sales leaders; sharing digital funnel ownership and revenue accountability for joint success.
Shape how marketing and sales work together: lead definitions, routing, prioritization, follow-up and feedback loops, with RevOps.
Influence sales process and campaign builds so marketing demand converts to revenue.
Use sales and customer insight to decide where to invest and what to test next

Lead Performance, Lifecycle And The Website

Lead organic search, AEO, paid search and paid social via both in-house and through agencies.
Own lifecycle and nurture programs, moving leads to qualified pipeline and reengaging stalled or lost opportunities.
Own the website as our primary conversion asset. Use insights from sales calls, live chat and customer conversations to sharpen messaging, improve visibility in AI-driven search results, and deliver a consistent roadmap.
Launch an automated and consistent online review program on G2 and Capterra to drive positive online sentiment

Run Marketing With AI

Use AI and agents to do real work: content and ad variants, campaign builds, analysis, scenario planning and reporting.
Help the team adopt AI in their own workflows, so the team can experiment and ship faster.
Build reporting that lets you see quickly where the funnel is off track, by region, channel and segment, and act on it.

Lead, Build, And Mentor a High-Performing Team

Lead a team covering paid and organic search, lifecycle marketing and website development, plus agency partners.
Foster a culture of experimentation with clear priorities, regular cadence, and transparent readouts.
Report weekly and quarterly to leadership on pipeline, channel performance, conversion and ROI.
Build, coach and grow a high-performing remote team.

What You Need To Succeed

Experience: 10+ years in B2B growth or demand generation at a high-growth SaaS company, including 3+ years leading a team. You've owned pipeline targets across more than one region.
Performance marketing depth: Hands-on with SEO, paid search and paid social, and confident managing paid budgets and CPC economics. You know what AEO is and have a point of view on how to win in AI search.
Lifecycle and conversion: You've built nurture programs and improved website conversion through steady testing.
AI fluency: You use AI tools daily and can show how they changed your output. You're comfortable connecting tools like Claude or ChatGPT to your marketing stack, building agents or AI workflows, and teaching your team to do the same.
Analytical agility: You can pull your own data, find where the funnel broke, and make a call. HubSpot and a BI tool (Looker, Tableau or similar) are part of your day.
Global performance: Owned pipeline targets across more than one region
Leadership and partnership: You build strong remote teams. You have a track record of co-owning pipeline and revenue with sales leaders, earning their trust and influencing how the two teams work together. You communicate performance clearly to executives.
Mindset: You are both a leader and a builder – focused on outcomes, effective at rolling your sleeves up and enabling your team to deliver results.
Nice to have: Marketing to accounting firms or professional services; fintech or payments; hybrid self-serve and sales-led motions; ABM tools such as DemandBase; Amplitude.

KPIs and success metrics

Global digital pipeline: Qualified leads and pipeline from digital channels, against target, by region and segment.
Trial and self-serve: Growth in trial, PQL (product-qualified lead) and self-serve signup volume.
Revenue impact: New customers and ARR sourced from digital and lifecycle programs.
Conversion: Website conversion and stage conversion through nurture to qualified pipeline.
Efficiency: Paid media ROI / ROAS and cost per qualified opportunity.
AI search visibility: Share of presence for priority queries in AI answers and organic search.
Speed of learning: Experiments shipped per month and time from spotting an issue to a fix.
Team: Team growth, engagement and AI adoption in day-to-day work

Compensation Details

Our salary bands are designed to reflect the range of skills and experience needed for the position and to allow room for growth. The final offer amount for this role will be dependent on state/location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

This role has a minimum annual base of CAD $160,000 and maximum annual salary of CAD $200,000 in the United States.

Our hiring process

We may use AI enabled tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as improving efficiency in scheduling and note taking. These tools are used responsibly and never replace human decision-making, all hiring decisions are made by our people.

We aim to keep the process transparent, respectful of your time, and as smooth as possible.

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement, experience comes in many forms, and diverse perspectives make our teams stronger.

Requirements

Description & Requirements

who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

The lululemon cybersecurity team helps protect the trust our guests, employees, and partners place in us. We work across technology and the business to understand risk, build practical security capabilities, and enable teams to move quickly and responsibly. We are looking for a Director of Security Operations to lead our Security Incident Response Team (SIRT), Threat Intelligence, Security Observability, and Detection Engineering capabilities. This leader will build an operation that treats detections as software: versioned, tested, measurable, and continuously improved.

Core Responsibilities

You will lead a global team of security engineers, analysts, threat hunters, intelligence practitioners, and incident responders. You will set the strategy and operating model for detecting, investigating, and responding to threats across lululemon’s technology environment. You are as comfortable discussing telemetry and detection logic with engineers as you are explaining business impact and response decisions to executives. You know that effective security operations is not measured by how many alerts a team can generate. It is measured by how reliably we identify meaningful threats, respond to them, and improve the systems around us.

Lead incident response

Own the SIRT strategy, incident response lifecycle, and operational readiness across cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, network, and application environments.
Lead coordination during significant incidents, establishing clear decision-making, escalation, communications, and recovery processes.
Partner with technology teams, Legal, Privacy, Communications, Risk, and other stakeholders to manage incidents and their business impact.
Run exercises and post-incident reviews that result in owned, tracked improvements to detection, response, and resilience.
Establish a sustainable global coverage model, including on-call and external partnerships where appropriate.

Build detection as code

Set the direction for a detection engineering program that manages detection logic, queries, rules, and response workflows as version-controlled code.
Establish engineering practices for peer review, automated testing, deployment, documentation, tuning, and retirement of detections.
Use threat modeling, incident learnings, threat intelligence, and adversary behavior to prioritize detection coverage against meaningful risks.
Validate detections continuously through simulation, replay, purple teaming, and other appropriate testing methods.
Reduce alert fatigue by improving signal quality, enriching context, and automating repeatable work while retaining human judgment for consequential decisions.

Own security observability

Define the telemetry strategy needed to investigate threats across identities, systems, applications, cloud services, and data flows.
Partner with engineering and platform teams to build reliable, secure, and cost-conscious telemetry pipelines, including clear ownership, data quality, retention, and access controls.
Identify and address visibility gaps, including those created by changes in infrastructure, SaaS adoption, and emerging technologies.
Guide the evolution and consolidation of security operations tooling, including decisions about what to build, buy, retain, or retire.

Turn intelligence into action

Lead a threat intelligence capability that identifies and communicates threats relevant to lululemon’s business, technology, and operating environment.
Translate intelligence into prioritized detections, hunts, defensive improvements, and incident readiness.
Build trusted relationships with industry peers, partners, and relevant information-sharing communities.

Build the team and program

Hire, develop, and retain a diverse, high-performing team. Create clear career paths and a healthy operating environment for people doing demanding work.
Set a multi-year roadmap, operating budget, and investment priorities aligned with business risk and technology strategy.
Define meaningful measures of effectiveness, such as detection coverage and validation, telemetry health, alert quality, time to detect and contain, and completion of post-incident improvements.
Communicate security operations performance, material risks, and investment tradeoffs clearly to technical teams and executive leaders.
Work with security and technology partners to meet applicable regulatory and contractual obligations, and provide evidence of operational effectiveness.

Qualifications

Approximately 8 years of experience in technology, including at least 5 years leading security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or closely related teams.
Experience building or evolving security operations capabilities for a complex, global organization.
Demonstrated experience leading significant security incidents and coordinating technical responders and business stakeholders through investigation, containment, and recovery.
Strong technical understanding of detection engineering and security observability, including logging pipelines, detection logic, security analytics, and automation.
Experience applying software engineering practices to security operations, such as version control, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration and deployment.
Experience detecting and responding to threats across cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, and application environments.
Experience using threat intelligence and adversary frameworks, such as MITRE ATT&CK, to inform detection priorities and assess coverage.
Experience designing or operating incident response processes informed by frameworks such as NIST, and measuring whether those processes work in practice.
Sound judgment in balancing security outcomes, operational workload, cost, privacy, and business impact.
Ability to influence across organizational boundaries, communicate clearly under pressure, and translate technical risk into actionable business decisions.
A track record of developing people and creating inclusive, accountable teams.

Valuable Additional Experience

Building or scaling purple-team, threat-hunting, or detection validation programs.
Applying AI and automation to security operations with appropriate testing, oversight, and access controls.
Working with managed detection and response providers, incident response partners, or globally distributed operations.
Investigating threats involving software supply chains, development pipelines, and machine or service identities.

must haves

Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.
Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.
Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.
Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.

Additional Notes

Authorization to work in Canada is required for this role.

As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program and equity offerings , subject to program eligibility requirements.

Description

Job Overview:

The Vice President, General Ledger Accounting
will lead the General Ledger Accounting function for an assigned portfolio of markets and regions. The Vice President is accountable for the overall performance of the GL teams that prepare, review and deliver monthly financial statements and related client deliverables for the communities supported within that portfolio.

Reporting to the SVP, Client Accounting, the Vice President will establish the strategic direction, operating priorities and performance expectations for the assigned GL organization. The role will work closely with market and regional leaders, Financial Management leadership and Client Accounting Shared Services partners to ensure financial statements are accurate, timely and supported by consistent processes, strong controls, effective issue escalation and disciplined performance management.

The Vice President will lead transformation and standardization across the assigned portfolio while ensuring the operating model remains responsive to local market needs, management agreements, governing documents and client expectations. The ideal candidate is a strategic, technically strong and service-oriented leader who can develop leaders, create accountability, resolve complex reporting issues and improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of financial statement delivery.

Due to the global nature of this position, the Vice President should be comfortable working across multiple time zones (Pacific Standard Time to Eastern Standard Time), within reason.

Job Responsibilities

The job duties listed are typical examples of the work performed by positions in this job classification. Not all duties assigned to every position are included, nor is it expected that all positions will be assigned every duty.

General Ledger Accounting

Provide executive ownership of the monthly close and financial statement reporting cycle for all communities within the assigned portfolio, ensuring accurate and timely delivery in accordance with internal policies and procedures, regulatory requirements, management agreements, property governing documents and client expectations.
Establish the portfolio’s operating rhythm, reporting timetables, quality standards, review protocols, escalation paths and delivery-tracking requirements for monthly financial statements.
Ensure the integrity of general ledger activity, including account reconciliations, accruals, prepaid expenses and amortization, fixed assets, interfund and reserve activity, cost recovery billings and other client deliverables.
Serve as the senior escalation authority for complex accounting matters, financial statement exceptions, late or at-risk deliverables and significant client or operational issues within the assigned portfolio.
Oversee GL support for annual client audits and budgets, special assessments, loans, mortgages and other significant client financial obligations.
Establish and monitor service level and key performance indicators for financial statement delivery
Drive leadership accountability for results against service-level and key performance indicators, reviewing performance regularly and leading corrective action plans where targets are missed.
Build the leadership capability, succession plans, organizational structure and workforce capacity required to support client growth, retention and changing business needs.
Attract, develop and retain high-caliber leaders and accounting professionals while promoting a culture of collaboration, accountability, trust and service excellence.

Business Partner

Serve as the senior Client Accounting business partner for market presidents, regional leaders, Financial Management leadership and other senior stakeholders within the assigned portfolio.
Partner with the VP, Accounts Receivable and Resales; VP, Accounts Payable; Senior Director, Treasury Services; and other Client Accounting leaders to ensure cohesive end-to-end service delivery and timely resolution of cross-functional issues.
Translate portfolio performance, operational trends and accounting risks into clear recommendations and decisions for the SVP, Client Accounting and senior market leadership.
Build strong relationships with supported markets to understand local culture, client requirements and operating needs while reinforcing enterprise standards and shared-services objectives.
Act as a senior resource for board members, property and association managers and other stakeholders by leading the resolution of significant accounting and financial reporting matters.
Represent General Ledger Accounting in senior leadership forums, cross-functional initiatives and major business decisions affecting client accounting and reporting.

Financial Planning

Develop and manage the GL operating budget for the assigned portfolio, including headcount planning, forecasts, productivity assumptions and variance analysis.
Align staffing, leadership capacity and workload to the monthly close cycle, client growth, market transitions and service requirements.
Develop business cases and investment recommendations for organizational changes, systems, automation, training and process improvement initiatives.
Monitor portfolio capacity and cost-to-serve indicators and take action when workload or service demand exceeds available resources.

People Management

Lead a team of 125+ associates through a senior leadership structure within North America
Attract, develop and retain diverse, high-caliber talent, while developing an engaged team to build the capabilities required for the organization to perform at high levels.
Promote a culture of collaboration, trust and support.
Clearly define and communicate performance responsibilities, goals, expectations and objectives.
Regularly evaluate teams to determine performance and whether company standards for work performance are met. If expectations are not met, are responsible for coaching and corrective actions.
Conduct ongoing performance management activities by providing constructive feedback and coaching through regular check-ins, structured one-on-one meetings, mid-year touchpoints and annual reviews.

Project Management

Provide executive sponsorship and governance for large-scale GL initiatives affecting the assigned portfolio, including market integrations, client transitions and accounting platform migrations.
Establish project objectives, decision rights, accountability, milestones, risks and escalation paths in partnership with project and functional leaders.
Ensure market and GL team readiness through effective planning, communication, training, change management and post-implementation support.
Provide clear status updates to senior leadership on timeline, accomplishments, decisions, risks, issues and required support.

Business Process Improvement

Lead the standardization and continuous improvement of GL processes, review practices, controls and workflows across the assigned markets and regions.
Establish and maintain standard operating procedures, service-level expectations, process documentation and governance for the GL function.
Partner with the Business Transformation and technology teams to define business requirements, prioritize enhancements, improve reporting capabilities and support adoption of enterprise accounting platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to automate, centralize or redesign work while maintaining accountability, control integrity and service quality.
Develop dashboards that provide visibility into financial statement delivery, quality, productivity, backlog, capacity, risk and technology adoption.
Use performance data, root-cause analysis and market feedback to identify systemic issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Share and implement leading practices across the GL organization and collaborate with peer functional leaders to improve end-to-end Client Accounting processes.

Compliance & Governance

Maintain an effective internal control environment over the general ledger and financial reporting functions, including segregation of duties, review controls, documentation standards and escalation procedures.
Ensure GL processes adhere to applicable accounting standards, federal and state requirements, company policies, standard operating procedures, management agreements and client-specific obligations.
Coordinate with internal and external auditors on audit requests, control reviews, year-end support and remediation activities.
Monitor regulatory, accounting and industry developments that may affect client accounting operations and lead implementation of required changes across the assigned portfolio.
Ensure the appropriate handling of sensitive and confidential information and safeguard client and company assets.

Additional Duties

Partner with the SVP, Client Accounting and other GL leaders to carry out the strategy, operating model and priorities for General Ledger Accounting.
Practice and adhere to FirstService Residential Global Service Standards.
Always conduct business with the highest standards of personal, professional and ethical conduct.
Anticipate needs across supported markets and manage department resources to provide timely and reliable service; prioritize and communicate when requests exceed capacity.
Complete special projects and perform other duties as assigned related to the stated objective for the position.

Skills & Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Strong analytical skills to perform data collection and benchmarking against best practices.
Manage in a no surprises manner; proactively communicate financial issues to leaders.
Ability to communicate a clear strategy and vision for General Ledger Accounting across our organization and have experience in leading change management initiatives that bring people, process, and technology together from different functional areas to deliver a quality financial services customer experience necessary.
Passion for gaining efficiency through process change while creating a positive team environment where we can recruit, develop, and retain talent.
Comfort with rolling out new technologies, automation and outsourcing to third parties to improve accuracy, timeliness and maximize efficiencies a must.
Knowledge leader in both financial accounting and the Condo/HOA industry. Sound business acumen and the ability to present practical solutions is a key requirement.
Experience interacting with or working through change management items with field operations personnel.
Exposure to a company/industry in rapid transformation (people, process, technology, customer experience).
Familiarity with projects focused on the implementation of new enterprise-wide technology platforms.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with high level of independence and accountability for their work.
Familiarity or practical experience with Agile program management methodology necessary.

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree plus an accounting designation is essential together with prior experience in a senior financial operations role.

Physical Requirements & Working Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Sitting at a desk for extended periods of time
Dexterity for keyboard and mouse use
Ability to lift up to 30 lbs.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Hours over and above normal office hours will occur, including evenings, holidays, and some weekends. Schedule is subject to change based on business needs.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Job Overview:

The Vice President, General Ledger Accounting
will lead the General Ledger Accounting function for an assigned portfolio of markets and regions. The Vice President is accountable for the overall performance of the GL teams that prepare, review and deliver monthly financial statements and related client deliverables for the communities supported within that portfolio.

Reporting to the SVP, Client Accounting, the Vice President will establish the strategic direction, operating priorities and performance expectations for the assigned GL organization. The role will work closely with market and regional leaders, Financial Management leadership and Client Accounting Shared Services partners to ensure financial statements are accurate, timely and supported by consistent processes, strong controls, effective issue escalation and disciplined performance management.

The Vice President will lead transformation and standardization across the assigned portfolio while ensuring the operating model remains responsive to local market needs, management agreements, governing documents and client expectations. The ideal candidate is a strategic, technically strong and service-oriented leader who can develop leaders, create accountability, resolve complex reporting issues and improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of financial statement delivery.

Due to the global nature of this position, the Vice President should be comfortable working across multiple time zones (Pacific Standard Time to Eastern Standard Time), within reason.

Job Responsibilities

The job duties listed are typical examples of the work performed by positions in this job classification. Not all duties assigned to every position are included, nor is it expected that all positions will be assigned every duty.

General Ledger Accounting

Provide executive ownership of the monthly close and financial statement reporting cycle for all communities within the assigned portfolio, ensuring accurate and timely delivery in accordance with internal policies and procedures, regulatory requirements, management agreements, property governing documents and client expectations.
Establish the portfolio’s operating rhythm, reporting timetables, quality standards, review protocols, escalation paths and delivery-tracking requirements for monthly financial statements.
Ensure the integrity of general ledger activity, including account reconciliations, accruals, prepaid expenses and amortization, fixed assets, interfund and reserve activity, cost recovery billings and other client deliverables.
Serve as the senior escalation authority for complex accounting matters, financial statement exceptions, late or at-risk deliverables and significant client or operational issues within the assigned portfolio.
Oversee GL support for annual client audits and budgets, special assessments, loans, mortgages and other significant client financial obligations.
Establish and monitor service level and key performance indicators for financial statement delivery
Drive leadership accountability for results against service-level and key performance indicators, reviewing performance regularly and leading corrective action plans where targets are missed.
Build the leadership capability, succession plans, organizational structure and workforce capacity required to support client growth, retention and changing business needs.
Attract, develop and retain high-caliber leaders and accounting professionals while promoting a culture of collaboration, accountability, trust and service excellence.

Business Partner

Serve as the senior Client Accounting business partner for market presidents, regional leaders, Financial Management leadership and other senior stakeholders within the assigned portfolio.
Partner with the VP, Accounts Receivable and Resales; VP, Accounts Payable; Senior Director, Treasury Services; and other Client Accounting leaders to ensure cohesive end-to-end service delivery and timely resolution of cross-functional issues.
Translate portfolio performance, operational trends and accounting risks into clear recommendations and decisions for the SVP, Client Accounting and senior market leadership.
Build strong relationships with supported markets to understand local culture, client requirements and operating needs while reinforcing enterprise standards and shared-services objectives.
Act as a senior resource for board members, property and association managers and other stakeholders by leading the resolution of significant accounting and financial reporting matters.
Represent General Ledger Accounting in senior leadership forums, cross-functional initiatives and major business decisions affecting client accounting and reporting.

Financial Planning

Develop and manage the GL operating budget for the assigned portfolio, including headcount planning, forecasts, productivity assumptions and variance analysis.
Align staffing, leadership capacity and workload to the monthly close cycle, client growth, market transitions and service requirements.
Develop business cases and investment recommendations for organizational changes, systems, automation, training and process improvement initiatives.
Monitor portfolio capacity and cost-to-serve indicators and take action when workload or service demand exceeds available resources.

People Management

Lead a team of 125+ associates through a senior leadership structure within North America
Attract, develop and retain diverse, high-caliber talent, while developing an engaged team to build the capabilities required for the organization to perform at high levels.
Promote a culture of collaboration, trust and support.
Clearly define and communicate performance responsibilities, goals, expectations and objectives.
Regularly evaluate teams to determine performance and whether company standards for work performance are met. If expectations are not met, are responsible for coaching and corrective actions.
Conduct ongoing performance management activities by providing constructive feedback and coaching through regular check-ins, structured one-on-one meetings, mid-year touchpoints and annual reviews.

Project Management

Provide executive sponsorship and governance for large-scale GL initiatives affecting the assigned portfolio, including market integrations, client transitions and accounting platform migrations.
Establish project objectives, decision rights, accountability, milestones, risks and escalation paths in partnership with project and functional leaders.
Ensure market and GL team readiness through effective planning, communication, training, change management and post-implementation support.
Provide clear status updates to senior leadership on timeline, accomplishments, decisions, risks, issues and required support.

Business Process Improvement

Lead the standardization and continuous improvement of GL processes, review practices, controls and workflows across the assigned markets and regions.
Establish and maintain standard operating procedures, service-level expectations, process documentation and governance for the GL function.
Partner with the Business Transformation and technology teams to define business requirements, prioritize enhancements, improve reporting capabilities and support adoption of enterprise accounting platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to automate, centralize or redesign work while maintaining accountability, control integrity and service quality.
Develop dashboards that provide visibility into financial statement delivery, quality, productivity, backlog, capacity, risk and technology adoption.
Use performance data, root-cause analysis and market feedback to identify systemic issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Share and implement leading practices across the GL organization and collaborate with peer functional leaders to improve end-to-end Client Accounting processes.

Compliance & Governance

Maintain an effective internal control environment over the general ledger and financial reporting functions, including segregation of duties, review controls, documentation standards and escalation procedures.
Ensure GL processes adhere to applicable accounting standards, federal and state requirements, company policies, standard operating procedures, management agreements and client-specific obligations.
Coordinate with internal and external auditors on audit requests, control reviews, year-end support and remediation activities.
Monitor regulatory, accounting and industry developments that may affect client accounting operations and lead implementation of required changes across the assigned portfolio.
Ensure the appropriate handling of sensitive and confidential information and safeguard client and company assets.

Additional Duties

Partner with the SVP, Client Accounting and other GL leaders to carry out the strategy, operating model and priorities for General Ledger Accounting.
Practice and adhere to FirstService Residential Global Service Standards.
Always conduct business with the highest standards of personal, professional and ethical conduct.
Anticipate needs across supported markets and manage department resources to provide timely and reliable service; prioritize and communicate when requests exceed capacity.
Complete special projects and perform other duties as assigned related to the stated objective for the position.

Skills & Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Strong analytical skills to perform data collection and benchmarking against best practices.
Manage in a no surprises manner; proactively communicate financial issues to leaders.
Ability to communicate a clear strategy and vision for General Ledger Accounting across our organization and have experience in leading change management initiatives that bring people, process, and technology together from different functional areas to deliver a quality financial services customer experience necessary.
Passion for gaining efficiency through process change while creating a positive team environment where we can recruit, develop, and retain talent.
Comfort with rolling out new technologies, automation and outsourcing to third parties to improve accuracy, timeliness and maximize efficiencies a must.
Knowledge leader in both financial accounting and the Condo/HOA industry. Sound business acumen and the ability to present practical solutions is a key requirement.
Experience interacting with or working through change management items with field operations personnel.
Exposure to a company/industry in rapid transformation (people, process, technology, customer experience).
Familiarity with projects focused on the implementation of new enterprise-wide technology platforms.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with high level of independence and accountability for their work.
Familiarity or practical experience with Agile program management methodology necessary.

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree plus an accounting designation is essential together with prior experience in a senior financial operations role.

Physical Requirements & Working Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Sitting at a desk for extended periods of time
Dexterity for keyboard and mouse use
Ability to lift up to 30 lbs.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Hours over and above normal office hours will occur, including evenings, holidays, and some weekends. Schedule is subject to change based on business needs.

System Ownership: Manage audit-related modules within the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS), including support of configuration, UAT, and documentation.
Team Leadership: Lead and develop a team of 3–5 auditors, providing coaching, mentorship, and performance management.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with PV Operations, Quality, and Regulatory teams to ensure audit outcomes drive continuous improvement.
Strategic Influence: Contribute to policy development and influence PV compliance strategy across the organization.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience, including team development and performance management.
Qualified Lead Auditor with active certification.
Master’s degree and 5+ years in pharmacovigilance or pharmaceutical industry; or Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years relevant experience.
Minimum of 5 years’ experience driving Global programs to resolve quality compliance issues (directly).
Experience with Pharmaceutical QMS requirements and regulatory requirements including but not limited to cGMP, GDP, GPvP, GCP and GLP.

Desired Characteristics

Experience with Medical Device QMS requirements and regulatory requirements including but not limited to FDA CFR 21 820 and ISO 13485.
Prior Veeva and TrackWise Digital experience a plus.
Prior health authority experience a plus.
IRCA, ASQ (CQE, CQA, etc.) and/or Lean Certification a plus (green belt, black belt).
Extensive experience in the Medica Device and Pharmaceutical industry.
Understanding of product quality improvement using tools such as Six Sigma, DFR.
Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
Exceptional conflict-resolution skills.
Ability to interface with top organizational leadership and internal and external customers, responding in a professional manner.
Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to prioritize and drive multiple programs.
Ability to energize others by building a connection with the team through personal involvement and trust, providing feedback and coaching to develop others, and accountability of actions.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English.
Integrity: Accepting and adhering to high ethical, moral, and personal values in decisions, communications, actions, and when dealing with others.
Ability to travel globally up to 15%.

new_jobs.description:
This role on BMO’s Corporate Real Estate (CRE) team is responsible for the oversight and delivery of BMO’s office and critical environments projects globally. The role includes the leadership of BMO’s internal team of professionals who oversee delivery through BMO’s third-party service providers and ensures a globally consistent and integrated approach.

The position is a key point of integration within the CRE team and with the bank’s other internal support functions who help deliver real estate projects including technology, procurement, security, finance and risk. It also serves as a liaison with BMO’s internal lines of business during project execution to ensure project objectives are achieved.

The ideal candidate is an experienced real estate leader with proven delivery capabilities, excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment on complex mission-critical initiatives.

Key Accountabilities For Office And Critical Environments Projects

Team Development

Leads, manages and develops BMO’s internal team responsible for the oversight of all office and critical environments (CE) projects globally.
Provide direction, coaching, prioritization and performance oversight to the BMO project team.
Establishes consistent delivery standards, practices and performance expectations, and drives continuous improvement.
Fosters a culture aligned to BMO’s purpose, values and strategy, promotes inclusion, establishes clear expectations and holds the team accountable for results.

Cross-Functional Alignment

Acts as relationship lead and trusted advisor to BMO leadership, project sponsors and stakeholders, aligning business objectives, priorities and measures of success with portfolio strategy and delivery.
Ensures cross-functional alignment across the various CRE teams to ensure that responsibilities, handoffs & accountabilities are clear throughout the real estate life-cycle from strategy through to operations.
Ensures active engagement with all operations teams and leadership through planning, commissioning, and the transition to operations.
Leads alignment and builds relationships with CRE’s enterprise support partners, including Technology, Security, Procurement, Finance and Risk.
Leads the resolution of issues, removes roadblocks and escalates material risks, unresolved commitments and decisions.

Delivery Accountability, Oversight & Strategy

Accountable for the delivery of all BMO’s portfolio of office and CE projects including determining the appropriate levels of internal oversight, integration, reporting and governance.
Oversight of all priorities, sequencing, resources and interdependencies to enable consistent and effective delivery of projects, which also includes any office and CE programs.
Monitors project performance and provides executive reporting on progress, financial performance, risks, issues, decisions and required actions.
Drives timely stakeholder requirements, resources, commitments, decisions and approvals required to meet project delivery objectives.
Provides project sponsors and BMO leadership with strategic advice on business cases, priorities, key decisions, risks, trade-offs, and realization of expected business benefits.
Accountable for capital stewardship, including project budgeting, forecasting, change control, contingency management and adherence to BMO capital governance and approval requirements.
Provides change leadership, ensuring stakeholder readiness, communications and change management activities to support achievement of expected business benefits.

Supplier Oversight & Third-Party Risk Management

Manages and builds strong partnerships with third-party service delivery partners and provides strategic direction and oversight of their performance.
Accountability for delivery, service quality and defined outcomes including key delivery metrics including scope, schedule and budget targets.
Ensures delivery by third parties is consistent with contractual agreements (MSAs) and aligned with BMO requirements, enterprise standards and approved objectives
Advises on the performance and selection of all project service delivery partners, including participating in BMO Procurement’s evaluation and selection process

Governance, Risk and Compliance Management

Ensures compliance within BMO’s governance, risk & regulatory requirements including enterprise project and program management requirements.
Proactively identifies interdependencies, risks and stakeholder impacts and ensures appropriate mitigation and resolution strategies are established
Leads and represents projects and programs in governance forums, ensuring decisions, actions, accountabilities and escalations are followed through to completion.
Establishes and maintains appropriate controls related to projects and acts as liaison with internal audit and risk groups where appropriate.

Qualifications

9+ years of relevant experience and/or certification in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Demonstrated experience leading and developing senior program and project management professionals responsible for complex, interdependent initiatives.
Extensive experience leading large Corporate Real Estate office projects and programs involving business groups, enterprise functions and third-party service delivery partners.
Experience leading mission critical engineering projects and programs.
Experience leading projects across multiple geographies and working effectively with regional stakeholders is an asset.
Strong knowledge of project and program management methodologies, governance, financial management and risk management.
Project Management Professional (PMP) designation from the Project Management Institute (PMI) is an asset.
Strong executive presence, with the ability to translate complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and required actions.
Expert stakeholder management skills.
Expert influence and negotiation skills.
Expert verbal and written communication skills.
Expert analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Strong collaboration and cross-functional leadership skills.
Ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities and challenging stakeholder environments effectively.

BMO Risk Accountability

Takes measured risks while protecting the Bank by applying BMO’s Risk Management Framework in the execution of the role, in line with BMO’s Risk Culture and approved Risk Appetite.
Makes sound, risk-informed decisions that align with business strategy, protect assets and adhere to applicable policies, standards, procedures, laws and regulations.
Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.
